Select distinct molecule ChEMBL ID, name, maximum phase, molecule type, and canonical SMILES for all compounds reported in document CHEMBL4011581. Join docs to compound_records on doc_id, then to molecule_dictionary on molregno, and inner join compound_structures on molregno to require canonical SMILES. Filter by docs.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL4011581'. Return the columns molecule_chembl_id, molecule_name, max_phase, molecule_type, canonical_smiles. Sort by molecule_chembl_id ascending.
